snippet.title: Close the Sky | Trailer
snippet.description:
Close the Sky is out now in Early Access on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5062880/

An RTS about modern air war. Build up your city, set up radars and air defense like Patriot and Iron Dome, and send Shaheds, FPV drones and ballistic missiles at the enemy's city. They're doing the same thing to you the whole time.
